error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot do this. Revealing payloads needs the run.payload permission (owners and admins).
error.RUN_NOT_FOUND: This run is not part of this course.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Choose a reason before revealing the payload.
error.INVALID_INPUT: Give a reason of at least 10 characters.
error.RUN_ALREADY_RETRIED: This run was already retried once. Open the run the retry started instead.
error.RUN_NOT_ENDED: This run is still live (or waiting on an uncertain call). Cancel it or wait for it to end before retrying.
error.RUN_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only a run that failed, or ended with an uncertain provider call, can be retried.
error.RUN_RETRY_UNSUPPORTED: Companion, research and written-answer runs answer one request; ask again through that request instead.
error.SUPERVISION_STOPPED: AI supervision is stopped for this learner. Resume it before retrying.
error.SUPERVISION_CONSENT_WITHDRAWN: The learner withdrew consent for AI supervision since this run. It was not retried.
error.ENROLLMENT_CLOSED: This enrollment is closed. Its record is not changed after closure.
error.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A different request was already sent with this key. Reload and try again.
error.unknown: The inspector could not complete this. Nothing was revealed or changed.
